Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that validates required structured fields and confidence scores using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import documentai_v1beta3 as documentai
from google.protobuf import json_format

def extract_structured_data(file_path: str, required_fields: list) -> dict:
    # Initialize the Document AI client
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # Specify the processor ID and API endpoint (replace with your own)
    processor_id = "projects/your-project/locations/your-location/processors/your-processor"
    base_url = f"https://{documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient.LOCATION_HOST}"

    # Set up the request
    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()
    
    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=image_content, mime_type="application/pdf")
    request = documentai.ProcessDocumentRequest(
        name=processor_id, 
        raw_document=raw_document, 
        inline_text=False, 
        enable_schema_validation=True
    )

    # Make the API request
    response = client.process_document(request=request, options={"api_endpoint": base_url})

    # Convert the response to JSON
    doc_json = json_format.MessageToJson(response.document)

    # Parse the JSON to extract structured data
    structured_data = {}
    for entity in response.document.entities:
        field_name = entity.display_name
        if field_name in required_fields:
            structured_data[field_name] = {
                "value": entity.properties[0].normalized_value.text if entity.properties else None,
                "confidence": entity.confidence
            }

    # Validate required fields and confidence scores
    for field in required_fields:
        if field not in structured_data or structured_data[field]["value"] is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Required field '{field}' is missing or has no value.")
        if structured_data[field]["confidence"] < 0.7:
            raise ValueError(f"Confidence score for field '{field}' is below the threshold of 0.7.")

    return structured_data
